pdf_fonts.title: Helvetica-Bold or bundled Bitstream Vera Sans Bold
pdf_fonts.body: Helvetica or bundled Bitstream Vera Sans

rules: For PDF: Ensure high readability, formal tone. Title at 14pt-16pt, body at 11pt-12pt. Use 1.5 line spacing for premium feel.
Follow existing CSS variables in dashboard-theme.css and index.css for UI.
PDF must be strictly black and white text for formal legal appearance.

layouts.ui_form_layout: Bento-style or dense grid for creator details. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 with gap-4.
layouts.creator_card: Wrap each creator's fields in a distinct container using .rm-card or border with bg-white/5. Include internal padding (p-4 or p-5) to prevent text collision.
layouts.signature_section: Provide tabs or toggle between 'Upload Image' and 'Draw Signature'. Canvas should have a clear border and contrast.
layouts.pdf_layout: A4 size. Generous margins (e.g., 1 inch / 72 points). Centered bold title. Justified body paragraphs. Signature block right-aligned at the bottom. Appendix on a new page.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Subtle shadows for creator cards to separate them from the modal background
visual_enhancers.signature_canvas: Light background (even in dark mode) or high-contrast stroke for the signature pad to ensure visibility and premium feel. Add 'Clear' button as a ghost button.

frontend: 1. Inside `SupportTicketModal.jsx` (or a new sub-component `ContentIdClaimForm.jsx`), conditionally render the Content ID form when `form.category === 'content_id_claim'`.
2. Add a dynamic list of 'Creators' (Pencipta). Each creator must have: Nama Lengkap Sesuai KTP, NIK, Domicile (Alamat), Signing City.
3. Add mandatory Track Selection for the claim.
4. Implement KTP Upload: mandatory file input (PNG/JPG/PDF) per creator.
5. Implement Signature: Allow switching between 'Upload Signature' and 'Draw Signature' (using a canvas library like react-signature-canvas or native HTML5 canvas).
6. Ensure all inputs use the existing `.rm-input` and `.rm-label` classes.
7. Add appropriate `data-testid` to all new fields (e.g., `data-testid='creator-name-0'`).
8. Maintain the modal's responsiveness and scrolling behavior.
backend: 1. Extend the FastAPI ticket creation endpoint to accept the new Content ID fields (creators list, tracks, signatures, KTP files).
2. Generate the PDF using ReportLab upon ticket submission.
3. PDF Content: Title 'SURAT PERNYATAAN KEPEMILIKAN HAK CIPTA ATAS LAGU'. Include non-infringement statements, dynamic list of creators, NIK, Domicile, and selected tracks.
4. PDF Styling: No letterhead, no letter number. Formal and premium typographic layout.
5. Append the uploaded KTP images as 'LAMPIRAN FOTO KTP PENULIS' on a new page in the generated PDF.
6. Save the generated PDF and attach it to the support ticket so the admin/label can download it.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER: use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
